ide.judul_kerja: Micro-Horror Drama: The Whispering Well of 1920
ide.sudut: Format mikro-drama horor atmosferik 60 detik yang memanfaatkan potongan foto arsip vintage, animasi gerak halus, dan narasi bahasa Inggris bernuansa mencekam tanpa memperlihatkan wajah.
ide.kenapa_nonton: Mengambil tren 'Microdramas on YouTube Shorts' dari berita minggu ini, mengemas cerita horor sejarah singkat yang membuat penonton penasaran dan ingin menonton episode lanjutannya.

ide.judul_kerja: 3 AM Ambient Lore: The Lost Radio Frequency of Station 7
ide.sudut: Pengalaman audio-visual atmosferik horor murni, menampilkan animasi loop sinematik TV analog tua di tengah hutan malam hari dengan perpaduan suara ambient hujan, radio static, dan narasi kisah misteri singkat.
ide.kenapa_nonton: Menyasar penikmat audio ambience dan creepy aesthetic di luar negeri; format loop yang mulus terbukti efektif menaikkan retensi penonton Shorts.

ide.judul_kerja: Real Dark History: The Dancing Plague of 1518
ide.sudut: Kisah nyata sejarah kelam yang dikemas ala dokumenter horor singkat menggunakan lukisan klasik yang didigitalkan (pan-and-scan), efek suara atmosferik, dan narasi cerita sejarah misterius.
ide.kenapa_nonton: Merujuk pada tren perubahan durasi dan kebiasaan penonton yang menyukai konten fakta sejarah bernuansa misteri tanpa perlu interaksi wajah pembuat konten.

hasil.hook: In 1920, an entire village disappeared... leaving only a whispering well.

naskah.narasi: In 1920, an entire village disappeared... leaving only a whispering well.
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: small text 'by Agung'] [Glitch & Fade In Animation] 1920: The Vanishing Village

naskah.narasi: Locals claimed the well didn't hold water. It held voices of the forgotten.
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: small text 'by Agung'] [Typewriter Animation] It didn't hold water...

naskah.narasi: When young Clara looked inside, she didn't see her reflection.
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: small text 'by Agung'] [Blur Reveal Animation] No reflection in the dark.

naskah.narasi: Instead, hands reached out from the deep, whispering a secret name she had never told a living soul.
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: small text 'by Agung'] [Creepy Flicker & Shake Animation] IT KNEW HER NAME.

naskah.narasi: By morning, Clara was gone. Only her small shoes remained at the edge... facing down into the abyss.
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: small text 'by Agung'] [Slow Dissolve Animation] Left facing downward...

naskah.narasi: If a dark well whispered your secret name... would you dare to look inside?
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: small text 'by Agung'] [Pulse & Glow Text Animation] Would you look inside?
